title: Send now, round 4 — up arrow, shared pencil, centred words

steps.path: The right end of a waiting message, above the message box
steps.headline: The arrow points up, and the pencil is now the same edit button as the quick chips row.
steps.changed: Up arrow in the accent send button. The pencil is the quick chips' own edit button, now one shared piece used in both places.
steps.notice: The waiting message's edit button looks exactly like the quick chips' edit button just below it.
steps.risk: The pencil box is a little more visible than the plain trash icon beside it.

steps.path: Hovering Send now on a waiting message
steps.headline: "Interrupt and Send Now" now sits centred in the button instead of slightly high.
steps.changed: The words are centred on the letters themselves, so they sit right in every theme's font.
steps.notice: In Meadow Mist the words no longer ride about a pixel high.

steps.path: Hovering Send now in the Midnight theme
steps.headline: In Midnight: the same up arrow, shared pencil and centred words.
steps.changed: Same changes, in a dark theme.
steps.notice: The pencil takes Midnight's own edit-button look, like the quick chips.
